scope.reason: Recompute paragraph text and line breaks from stored markup: retain a line break when its newline survives whitespace trimming and drop it when the newline is removed; paragraph AST has no separate feature storage. Normalize repeated block identities and publisher head-matter order before reading stored decisions; AST identities and roles have no independent feature storage. Multiline preamble titles and document-unique block anchors are rebuilt from stored markup, alongside paragraph text, paragraph numbers and anonymization markers before whitespace trimming, including unpainted non-breaking-space redaction runs and uneven letter-spaced chunks witnessed by intact words; none has feature storage of its own. Recompute printed paragraph labels from stored raw: local duplicate or OCR markers preserve surrounding labels, and Czech and Slovak separate opinions have independent numbering scopes; AST roles and labels have no separate feature storage. Read files that set word gaps as no-break spaces at their text-layer seams: a plain space inside a word joins it, and one after a finished sentence before a numbered point restores the lost line break; paragraph AST has no separate feature storage. In files with plain word gaps too, the court's next numbered point or a part marker run onto a finished sentence opens its own line again, so ruling points and the reasoning are read apart; paragraph roles have no separate feature storage.
